parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN (default): Chinese
*   en-US: English
*   ja: Japanese

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: Specifies whether to monitor Ingress classes.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: Specifies whether to update the Ingress status.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The namespace whose resources you want to monitor.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The service source.

*   K8s: ACK cluster
*   NACOS: MSE Nacos instance

parameters.name: ToAuthorizeSecurityGroups
parameters.description: The list of security groups to be authorized. You can specify security groups to allow backend services to access data sources that you create.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the service source.

*   K8s: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
*   NACOS: Nacos instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse add-service-source --type NACOS --source MSE --address mse-00000000-nacos-ans.mse.aliyuncs.com:8848 --name nacos --gateway-unique-id gw-c70622ff52fe49beb29bea9a6f520000 --ingress-option-srequest IngressClass=com.test.xxx EnableStatus=true WatchNamespace=default EnableIngress=true --to-authorize-security-groups PortRange=8080/8080,9000/10000 Description=rule_for_xxx SecurityGroupId=sg-bp1acepclex0vmi10000 --group-list NACOS --path-list /test --accept-language zh-CN --region cn-hangzhou
